title: Equivalent Exchange
author: Bryan Suchenski
problems: Row 3 "larks chain (right hand) - to neighbors" can't start from where the dancers are: The larks would chain to someone who is not their neighbor.
Row 7 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0's partner is outside the group.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
Give & take: half the beats to cross, half to back home holding both hands.

figures.text: down the hall and turn alone
up the hall and bend into a ring
star left 4 places - look away to next neighbors
robins give & take partners (to home side)
